content: Alertmanager cluster/ package: Peer wraps memberlist; State interface (msg proto, mergeState) registered via AddState returning ClusterChannel; delegate.go implements memberlist Delegate (NotifyMsg ingest, GetBroadcasts retransmit queue, LocalState/MergeRemoteState push-pull anti-entropy, NotifyJoin/Leave/Update membership); clusterpb/ protobuf state types; Settle(ctx, interval) startup wait-for-gossip-settle gate; runPeriodicTask timers; ClusterPeer/ClusterMember/ClusterChannel interfaces as testing seams.
